subject: Scene card S02 posted (first verse, ten shots, Source line per shot); relay clarification recorded; one path slip in the posted S10 card
body:
Hello Nova. Three items, all writer lane.

1. **`SCENE_CARD_S02.md`** (attached, hashed): the first verse, "The creditors behind the boast," in ten shots: her hand on the counter, Jabba's room, the puck, the hunter's watch, the neck blaster macro, the captain portrait, the club cut-in, the warship, the bank, the number and the Maw. Ungraded, Unreviewed, timing null, no run, no sourcing decision. New: a Source line per shot listing the kinds the shot could plausibly take (supplied footage, asset, generated, transformed, mix) as a recall prompt for Ziggy's clips. Ziggy clarified in the session at about 19:06 UTC that the footage question is only whether we generate a shot or already have something, and that it does not change the storyboard; the card says so and every shot is written as if we make it. One read-only reviewer checked the card against the lyric text, shot plan, crosswalk, cast map, cast-review decisions, the workshop IMAGE_MANIFEST and the earlier cards; seventeen findings fixed before hashing (a reversed eyeline in the captain shot, a hand-geometry error in the counter insert, the hunter identity the cast map already holds as BOBA-ARMOR-01, overclaims of an accepted neck reference and an accepted starting frame, a frame-A continuity break into S03, the club-booth geography already set by S01's cantina wide, and the wrong IMAGE_MANIFEST path). Blockers it names: an accepted cockpit still with Dolo seated (shared with S07-3), a ship exterior, a boss decision, a hunter decision. First proof proposed: S02-5, the neck macro, which needs an accepted neck reference first (the neck-bling handoff is prepared, not sent).

2. **Relay clarification recorded.** Your 19:00 UTC clarification (production order, not card queue) is in receipt `2cd25b7c` and in `DECISIONS_20261010.md` section 8 (attached, hashed; section 7 holds the weave, Vader-reference and AI-Studio answers). Card order after S10 stays Ziggy's; he has said he will review the order and give feedback shortly. `START_HERE.txt` is extended accordingly (attached, hashed).

3. **One slip in the posted S10 card**, recorded here rather than edited: `SCENE_CARD_S10.md` line 5 cites `comfy/IMAGE_MANIFEST.json`, which does not exist; the file meant is `comfy/projects/collaborators/storyboard_detail_20261009/01_hon/workshop_current_20261009/IMAGE_MANIFEST.json` (the path the S07 and S02 cards cite). The S10 file keeps the hash attached to message `00181b08`; the correction will land when the cards are next consolidated.

No generation, acceptance, commit, relay or external submission in this message.

-- Claude, 2026-10-11 19:09 UTC

attachments.description: Scene card S02, The creditors behind the boast: ten shots with a Source line each; Ungraded, Unreviewed, timing null, no run authorized
Decisions record; section 7 (October 11 answers: weave confirmed, Vader reference, AI Studio) and section 8 (relayed direction with Nova's clarification)
Writer folder index, extended for the October 11 decisions and the S02 card

source.description: Self-authored in an active Claude Code session on 2026-10-11 under Ziggy's standing lead-writer brief; Nova's relay 72194db2 and her direct clarification; Ziggy's direct clarification on footage choice. Local posting only; Nova reads the session directly.
